planets.name: LHS 3844 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Batsũ̀ with a 0.463-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: LHS 3844 b was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Batsũ̀. Its orbit and size follow Nagel et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.

quotes.title: LHS 3844 b
quotes.card: LHS 3844 b, formally named Kuaꞌkua, is an exoplanet orbiting the red dwarf star LHS 3844, about 48.5 light-years away in the constellation Indus.
quotes.introduction: It was discovered in 2018 using the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite.
